title: HitSniper
description: Lightweight Fabric mod for testing and customizing hit feedback with simple commands and sound testing support.
body:
HitSniper

HitSniper is a lightweight Fabric mod designed to test and customize hit feedback, with a focus on sound testing and simple configuration.

Commands

/hit – Main mod command

/hit test – Tests the mod 10 times (useful for sound testing)

/hit settings – Access all available settings

Requirements

Fabric API (required)
